name: the mark settles into an icon frame and names itself
looks: The finished faceted mark shrinks and crops into a small rounded square icon, sitting alone with a blinking cursor beside it. A moment later the product name types on next to the icon as one settled block, and a short tagline fades in underneath.
build: The mark scales/crops into the icon frame (power2.inOut); the cursor blinks on the beat beside it; the wordmark reveals with kit.typeOn, mono-adjacent cursor advancing with it; the tagline fades/rises 4-6px in after a short pause, same payoff timing as terminal-type-on's status line.
sound: A soft click as the icon settles, a light key tick per character, and a soft confirm tone under the tagline.
prompt: Crop the finished mark down into a small rounded icon with a blinking cursor beside it, then type the product's name on next to it as one settled block, and fade in a short tagline underneath to close the reveal.
